title: Authorized work
notice: Record only accepted work. Incidents remain pending until a durable work, handover and payout hold is confirmed. Next review is due within one hour.
empty: Choose an assigned job to begin.
pending: Pending. Retry the same operation reference.
recorded: Observation recorded. This does not authorize release.
paused: Work paused. Follow the responsible next action.
denied: Current access denied. Request assignment review.
stale: Revision changed. Reconcile this operation before continuing.
unavailable: Unavailable. Retain this operation and retry.

select.emptyBody: No accepted options are currently available.

correction: Correct the entered values and submit again. No observation was recorded.
composition: This page is unavailable until its shared shell and private read contract are registered. Request service support for the current job.
